feeds.title: The Artful Parent
feeds.description: Jean Van't Hul is a writer, mother of two, and children's art enabler. The Artful Parent is the parent's resource for easy and fun kids art, family crafts, children's creativity, and process-oriented kids arts and crafts activities.

feeds.title: Artsy Craftsy Mom Blog
feeds.description: On the Artsy Crafty Mom blog, Shruti shares ideas, information and inspiration to encourage you to enjoy and share art & craft with your kids. She posts on kids art ideas, seasonal crafts, and family fun activities.

feeds.title: ARTBAR Blog
feeds.description: Bar Rucci will present the most innovative artists, curate the best crafts for the home and classroom and share creations from her children and studio at Art Bar. This blog is a place for her to share her passion of creative experiences as well as easy advice and ideas for bringing creativity into the lives of her readers.

feeds.title: Cassie Stephens Blog
feeds.description: An elementary art teacher blog with art projects and lessons, DIY projects and outfit photos as well as clothing I have made myself. Authored by Cassie Stephens.

feeds.title: Art For Kids Hub
feeds.description: At Art for Kids Hub, you'll find art projects and tips for your creative kids.

feeds.title: Arte a Scuola
feeds.description: Miriam Paternoster is an Italian art teacher in a North Italian middle school. This blog is a forum for art teachers and schools all over the world to discuss and explore lessons, educational methods and approaches.

feeds.title: Painted Paper Art
feeds.description: This is the place to find posts of fun, exciting projects created by elementary students from a school in Ohio. Bright and colorful photos to springboard lessons for anyone who loves to paint with children.

feeds.title: Eco Kids Art Blog
feeds.description: I'm Spramani Elaun. I help teachers and parents teach kids art.I share art teaching ideas, lessons, curriculum, resources and art training.

feeds.title: KinderArt Blog
feeds.description: The goal of Kinder Art has been and always will be, to make art lessons and educational information accessible to people around the world. In addition to the thousands of free art lesson plans, they offer printable activity pages, the art kitchen, educational links and articles, early childhood education resources and much more.

feeds.title: Mini Matisse
feeds.description: This blog is a conversation of how to teach our mini's. Contains articles on Art teaching, challenges, community events and Tips

feeds.title: Mrs. Knight's Smartest Artists
feeds.description: Fun art lessons by Mrs. Knight's Smartest Artists, Dolvin Elementary School, Johns Creek, Georgia.

feeds.title: Meri Cherry Blog
feeds.description: Meri Cherry Blog is an arts and crafts blog for kids and their families. Articles on Art adventure, Design, Graphic Art, Process Art and holiday craft

feeds.title: Teach Kids Art Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cheryl, and I'm a great supporter of children's art. I spent over 20 years teaching art to children and it was the most rewarding job I've ever had! This diverse set of experiences has taught me a lot, and I'm happy to keep sharing what I've learned in order to assist others find success teaching art to children!

feeds.title: The Quickdraw Blog
feeds.description: Follow the quickdraw blog to learn about drawing, coloring, painting, and many more fun creative activities for children and teens. Quickdraw is the online art series for kids and beginners that teaches them more about art through the help of short & fun tutorials.

feeds.title: Small Hands Big Art Blog
feeds.description: This is the small hands big art blog featuring art lessons for kids of all ages. Activities include painting, drawing, clay, collage, printmaking and construction.

feeds.title: Art with Kids Blog
feeds.description: Art with Kids is a kids art blog by Vicki Smith that shares art projects that are fun for children and adults.

feeds.title: *Fun Art 4 Kids
feeds.description: Ideas to inspire creative learning and growth!

feeds.title: Art Lessons For Kids
feeds.description: Art Lessons For Kids is a blog with all awesome lessons about art to help you with your planning and teaching. The lessons are geared towards students from Pre-Kinder to Grade Seven but also highly adaptable for any age group.

feeds.title: LaLay kids Tv
feeds.description: This blog was created showcasing Picture Coloring for Kids, Learning Colors, Counting, Shapes and more subjects for young learners around the toddler to preschool age.

feeds.title: Art Projects for Kids
feeds.description: Visit Art Projects for Kids blog to see classroom-tested lesson plans. Its mission is to promote creative living for children.

feeds.title: Art is Basic
feeds.description: My name is Marcia and I teach K-5 art at a small private school in Wisconsin. Through this blog, I share oodles of art project ideas, tips and tricks for managing the practical aspects of teaching art, and lots of inspiration from art & design.

feeds.title: Kids and Art Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Their mission is to team-up children who have been touched by cancer and their siblings with local Bay Area Artists. Together they will create art which will be sold at an auction. The proceeds from these auctions will be used towards art supplies, art therapy sessions for families.

feeds.title: Artful Kids
feeds.description: Hi - my name is Jude, and I am the owner of Artful Kids. I have been passionate about art and creativity for my entire life. While the Artful Kids blog continues to focus on sharing art activities and products for the Young at Art, the projects created for the blog give me the creative freedom to try new ideas, which in turn enriches and refreshes my own art practice.
